sources.title: AeroGen: Enhancing Remote Sensing Object Detection with Diffusion-Driven Data Generation
sources.snippet: Remote sensing image object detection (RSIOD) aims to identify and locate specific objects within satellite or aerial imagery. However, there is a scarcity of labeled data in current RSIOD datasets, which significantly limits the performance of current detection algorithms.
